test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The discovery of treasure under the Bermuda Triangle is probably a __hoax__
solution:
The correct answer is- **"Trick"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options, **"Trick"** is the most appropriate synonym of **"hoax"**.
 
• **Hoax:** a trick/ method of deception intended to fool others.
 
 
• **Example:** People were **hoaxed** by the fake matrimonial website.
 
 
 
• Thus, ***option 4) ***is the correct alternative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let us understand the meaning of other options as well.

__
 
• **Analogy: **a comparison of two, otherwise unrelated, things based on similarities in one specific area.
 
• **Bonanza:** something that generates tremendous opportunities or large earnings all of a sudden
 
• **Delusion: **something that is false or unreal but is perceived to be true or real.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• **Trick**: A trick refers to a cunning or deceitful action intended to deceive or manipulate someone. It involves using clever tactics or strategies to achieve a desired outcome. In the context of the sentence, "hoax" implies a deliberate deception, making "trick" a suitable synonym.
 
• **Delusion**: A delusion, on the other hand, refers to a persistent false belief or perception that is firmly held despite evidence to the contrary. It often involves a distorted view of reality and can be associated with mental health conditions such as schizophrenia or delusional disorder. While a hoax can create a temporary delusion, the focus is more on the act of deception rather than the enduring false belief itself.
 
• **Considering the context of the sentence you provided, "trick" is indeed a more appropriate synonym for "hoax."**
